title: Soofi S: A Sovereign, Open-Source Foundation Model for German and English
hook: A European consortium built a 30B model that activates just 3B parameters per token - and it beats every other European 'sovereign AI' model tested, including bigger ones.
key_points: Soofi S 30B-A3B is a Mixture-of-Experts hybrid of Mamba and Transformer layers: only 3B of 30B parameters activate per token.
Its Mamba design keeps the inference cache near-constant as context grows - a throughput edge for long, high-concurrency serving.
Pretrained on roughly 27 trillion tokens with deliberately up-weighted German data alongside English.
Matches dense 14-27B models on aggregate English/German benchmarks; posts the best code scores in both languages among 17 open models.
Beats every other European sovereign-AI baseline tested, including larger ones, plus Olmo 3 32B and Apertus 70B among open models.
content_html: A European consortium has released Soofi S 30B-A3B, a sovereign, fully open foundation model built specifically for German and English. Its headline trick is architectural: a Mixture-of-Experts hybrid of Mamba state-space layers and Transformer attention that activates only 3B of its 30B parameters per token, while keeping the inference cache nearly flat as context grows.
extra_html: Trained on roughly 27 trillion tokens with German deliberately up-weighted, Soofi S matches dense 14-27B models on aggregate English/German benchmarks and leads on code across both languages among 17 open base models - while beating every other European sovereign-AI model tested, including ones with more active parameters. It was built end-to-end on Deutsche Telekom's sovereign HPC cloud in Munich, and the team plans to release weights, checkpoints, full per-source data accounting, hyperparameters, and training/eval code under permissive terms. Read the paper via the source link.

related.title: What Is a Mixture of Experts?
related.hook: Instead of running every input through one big network, route each token to a few specialist sub-networks - total capacity grows without proportional compute.
